text:
tasha_marketing: Heads-up: planning to publish our new benchmark + product deep-dive on Tue Jul 14 16:00 PT / 23:00 UTC. Need to lock embargo partners, confirm asset types (CSV vs PNG), and finalize localization windows.

nate_pr: Noted. Which outlets are on the embargo list? Any requests for earlier pickup?

tasha_marketing: Core list is the usual 20. One EU outlet (infra-byte.eu) asked for 22:30 UTC pickup due to desk scheduling. We prefer unified window but can consider one controlled pre-release. Thoughts?

anita_legal: Legal: controlled pre-release allowed for up to 2 pre-vetted outlets only. Must sign the embargo addendum and we restrict assets to non-raw formats (PNG + one-paragraph summary). Also: avoid absolute "best" claims unless supported by stable numbers.

mina_intl: For translations: we can turn around ZA/SG languages plus JA/CN if final copy freezes by 02:00 PT. CSVs add localization overhead (numeric notes), so PNG-only saves ~3 hours.

ryan_social: Social ops: we'll schedule organic posts for the primary window and hold paid boosts until after T+1h. If we do any pre-release, we must pause auto-syndication to partners.

tasha_marketing: OK: decision items: (1) PNG-only for early partner assets, (2) allow infra-byte.eu early pickup at 22:30 UTC if they sign addendum, (3) content freeze 02:00 PT, translations by 08:00 PT.

nate_pr: I'll ping infra-byte and offer the addendum. If they sign, we'll grant pre-release limited to PNG + 250-word partner summary. Will request embargo compliance confirmation.

anita_legal: Addendum template ready. Nate, send the list of contacts and I'll batch-send legal copy for signatures.

pressops_bot: Reminder: release-checklist items open: legal addendum, partner FAQ, final build link, tracking params. Use /release-checklist to update status.

ryan_social: Quick partner snippet for outreach (copy/paste):
```
Publish: 2026-07-14 23:00 UTC (primary)
Permitted early pickup: 2026-07-14 22:30 UTC (infra-byte.eu only, if addendum signed)
Allowed assets: PNG graphs + 250-word summary
Tracking: utm_source=partner&utm_campaign=bench-jul
```

mina_intl: Minor ask: can we also include a simple Q&A bullet for translators explaining how we refer to quantization and latency? That helps keep localized phrasing consistent.

tasha_marketing: Good idea. I'll draft a 3-bullet translator guidance and add to partner FAQ.

nate_pr: One more note: ANZ outlet devpulse.au requested an interview slot inside the embargo window. Carmen, are you available for a quick 20-min? If not, Dev lead can do it.

carmen_ceo: I can do a brief high-level interview at T+0.25h if needed. Prefer to keep deep technical to the engineering lead.

anita_legal: Also flag: if any outlet asks to publish raw CSVs before the public release, deny request. CSVs only after public launch and with tracking.

pressops_bot: Action items (auto): [nate_pr - request infra-byte addendum signature], [anita_legal - batch-send addendum], [tasha_marketing - partner FAQ + translator guidance], [ryan_social - queue holds & paid boost schedule]. Checkpoint in 12h.

nate_pr: Sending outreach now. Will post confirmation here once addendum signed.

tasha_marketing: Thanks team. Posting partner FAQ draft in 45m. Keeping this thread as canonical for partner comms and embargo exceptions.
